description: Default policy. Comparing two different devices is high, info when the mismatch was allowed explicitly. A collection gap of a required probe is critical, of an optional probe medium; a probe that is not applicable with a reason is info. A changed device/os or device/host is medium. Every other added, removed or changed artifact, a baseline artifact that was not observed and a probe that moved between captured and not_applicable are low. Changes no rule matches get the default severity info.

rules.description: The baseline and the current bundle describe different devices.
A required probe was not captured.
An optional probe was not captured.
A probe is not applicable on this host and says why. It stays visible and does not block.
The operating system or host identity changed.
Any other artifact was added, removed or changed.
A baseline artifact, or some of its attributes, was not observed because its source probe was not captured.
A probe moved between captured and not_applicable.
